welcome: Make room for a better day
welcome_body: Small steps. A calmer rhythm. Build routines that work for you, even offline.
empty_today: A little space for something good
empty_body: Create a routine or choose a template to start your day.
premium_body: Unlimited routines, duplication and monthly insights. Your daily checklist, reminders and assistant stay free.
billing_blocked: Purchasing is unavailable until the publisher configures and verifies Amazon billing.
voice_help: Try: Create a morning routine. Add reading to my morning routine. Mark reading as complete.
voice_unavailable: Speech recognition is unavailable on this device. Type the same commands below.
voice_denied: Microphone access was denied. You can use text commands.
privacy_body: Routines and history are stored on your device. No analytics or advertising trackers are included. Your device speech service may send audio to its provider. Microphone use begins only when you tap the microphone. Amazon processes purchases. Backups are disabled; exporting a file gives you control of your data.
delete_confirm: Permanently delete routines and completion history? This cannot be undone.
no_history: Your completed steps will appear here.
today_subheading: One small step at a time.
day_complete: You made time for what matters.
day_encouragement: Keep a little promise to yourself.
collection_subheading: Build a day that feels like yours.
reminder_delivery: Reminders follow the device timezone and may be delayed by battery optimisation.
progress_method: Insights cover the last 7 or 30 local calendar days. Schedule edits and pauses apply from today; previous days keep their recorded schedule.
notifications_disabled: Notifications are disabled. Enable them in device settings to receive reminders.
languages_pending: Additional languages will appear after translation validation and review.
reminder_confirmation: Schedule a reminder %1$s at %2$s in the device timezone?
